name: Nogizaka
tagline: Shibuya in 11 minutes and Otemachi in 11 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 11 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 11 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 31.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 31.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 22.8 m to 32.8 m, a difference of 10.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 8 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 順和会山王病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is Sanno Medical Center, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥540,000 to ¥550,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the highest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For One room, 1K, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Nogizaka, but Roppongi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nogizaka. Roppongi also has the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line and Toei Oedo Line, which Nogizaka does not. With more lines, Roppongi is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Roppongi is 16 minutes quicker. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥17,000 more at Roppongi.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Aoyama-Itchome, but Nogizaka is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nogizaka. Aoyama-Itchome also has the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Toei Oedo Line, which Nogizaka does not. With more lines, Aoyama-Itchome is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Aoyama-Itchome is 14 minutes quicker. A one-room flat also costs about ¥15,000 less at Aoyama-Itchome. On the number of places to eat out, though, Nogizaka comes out ahead.

leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
